about_short_description.short_description: A YC-backed, pre-Series A and profitable startup that lets older folks use personal services like Lyft & Uber from a phone call.

product.name: On-Demand Senior Transportation Service
product.description: A phone-based service that enables seniors and disabled individuals to request rides from Uber, Lyft, and other providers without needing a smartphone.

product.name: Meal Delivery Service for Seniors
product.description: A service that arranges meal deliveries from providers like DoorDash to seniors and disabled individuals, accessible with or without a smartphone.

product.name: Grocery Delivery Service for Seniors
product.description: A phone-accessible service that helps seniors and disabled individuals order groceries from providers like Instacart without needing a smartphone.

product.name: Membership Plans for Service Access
product.description: Subscription plans that provide varying levels of access and support for GoGoGrandparent’s transportation, meal, and grocery services.
